```transcript
Factory ID: JR-MIU-WX-02521

[RESUME UNIT PLAYBACK]

CHOSEN UNIT NAME: KARI

CURRENT LOCATION: OUTSIDE JAZZ GARDEN BAR, COUNTRY OF LIEL, PLANET OF ZOMANIA, ORBITING STAR BLIUR, 37.5 LIGHTYEARS FROM LLAMANIAN TERRITORY

OBJECTIVE: KILL OLDRA AND CLAIM THE BOUNTY
```

The heavy rain pours down on me, I sat outside a sleazy bar going over the plan. The target was a wanted criminal to the Llamanian empire, I honestly didn’t care that much though. I needed enough to pay for my monthly subscription to life, and the Llamanians were paying more than enough. It would be nice not to need to murder other lifeforms, but that’s unfortunately not in the cards for me. Thankfully it was a simple “Walk in and shoot the unfortunate mark in the back of the head killing him instantly” type job.

I entered the bar, a jazz band playing a somber tune. Smoke was heavy in the air, a noxious combination of illicit grass and tobacco. I studied the room, scanning all the lifeforms in search of my target. I spotted them on a stool by the bar. I began my approach, feeling the stares of the other patrons. I stopped right behind Oldra, studying every single thing about them. They seemed to be heavily intoxicated so their reaction should be slowed; it makes things easier for me. “[Are you Oldra?]{Kari}” I questioned. Oldra turned around and responded with a gruff “[Yeah I am, what about it tin can? Are you brok-]{Oldra}” I interrupted them with a 10mm slug to their head. I put in two more rounds to be sure; Llamanians wanted them dead. I knew that one round isn’t enough in some cases.

I turned around to the other patrons of the bar. “[Sorry to disturb all of you. Official Llamanian bounty-hunting business. I’ll be taking my target and leaving.]{Kari}” Despite my explanation, the patrons seemed to be filled with a murderous intent. “[I understand that I have created a mess, but please lower your arms and I shall leave.]{Kari}” They weren’t about to back down. Darn, I didn’t want to kill anyone else, but I don't have much of a choice. “[It appears that peace is not an option here, if any survivors are impressed with this unit’s performance please check out other fine Jade RabbitⓇ products.]{Kari}”

The jazz band switched from a somber melancholic song to an adrenaline-pounding tune. I let off three shots and jumped behind the counter. I hit two of my attackers, but I think I only killed one. Bullets whizzed by me as my attackers let loose a torrent of gunfire. Bottles of various liquors shattered above me. I quickly grabbed a bottle of a nice everclear. The bartender was cowering behind the counter with me. I asked him if he had a lighter on him. He was confused, but he had one in his pockets. I reached in his pants and grabbed it, and ripped some cloth off his shirt. I soaked the scrap cloth in the alcohol, stuffed it in the bottle, and lit it aflame. I quickly tossed the firebomb over the counter. I heard the screams of a person being cooked to a medium-rare consistency and jumped back over the counter. While taking a few potshots at the attackers, I kicked a table towards a corner where a dog-man was spraying a submachine gun at me. I grabbed an elf and used him as a shield for an oncoming hail of lead. Noticing a severe lack of firepower, I grabbed a submachine gun and a semi-automatic shotgun that were dropped on the ground.

I jumped around the room spraying lead in all directions. I was like a dancer, but my symphony was the sounds of multiple high-caliber firearms. I slid across the bar counter letting bullets fly with reckless abandon. Watching the scoreboard on my HUD gave me a euphoric feeling. Violence may not be good, but I am good at it. I felt the heavy “chunk” of the borrowed firearms running out of ammo. The intense rush of my violence protocols slowly faded away. Blood splattered against the walls and floor like a macabre painting. Spent shell casings littered the floor, the smell of gunpowder heavy in the air. I dropped the stolen guns, I didn't need them anymore. I found Olda in the pile of bodies I had created. I put their corpse over my shoulder and left the bar in shambles.

**[END PLAYBACK]**
